errors.evidence: The description lists the bars and their values in an order (sorted by value: NI, HH, MV, SH, HB) that does not match their visual order on the x-axis (NI, MV, HH, SH, HB). Specifically, the description lists HH before MV, whereas on the chart, MV appears before HH.
